round1_to_round2.convergence_verdict: Mixed: partly independent agreement, partly anchoring on the round-1 supervisor file. (a) Independent: agents 1-4 each re-opened the StockAnalysis forecast pages and found that the round-1 supervisor's 49.5x peer median rested on extrapolated next-year EPS. They independently got 51.6x, which I confirmed. Agents 1, 3 and 4 also caught the round-1 supervisor's 3-month bill error (4.13% is the 2-month; the 3-month is 4.21%). Agents 3, 4 and 5 independently moved EV/FCF to a trailing FY27, GAAP-basis FCF, correcting the round-1 supervisor's basis. On ladders the agents did not anchor: every round-2 ladder median ($343-367) sits below the round-1 supervisor ladder median ($377), each agent built its own scenario mixture, and their FVs land below the supervisor's $284 rather than on it. (b) Anchored: all five copied the round-1 supervisor's Oct-2027 NTM EPS of $5.01 verbatim, including its mis-derived FY29 figure (see disagreements), and none re-derived it. Agents 2 and 4 copied the 9-peer EV/FCF median of 38.72x. Agent 5 copied the round-1 supervisor's CAGR-extrapolation method for peer next-year EPS, so it also carried the error. The round-1 supervisor's remark that 'deducting SBC would lower it further' likely pushed agents 1-4 toward heavier SBC-burdened DCF weights, and those DCFs are what put their FVs $20-25 below their relative-value methods. Net: the convergence on P/E inputs is largely anchored, the convergence on peer multiples is independent and verified, and the ladders are independent.

disagreements.topic: Oct-2027 NTM EPS $5.01: a round-1 supervisor figure copied by all five
disagreements.positions: All five use $5.01 = 0.816 x FY28 $4.88 + 0.184 x FY29 $5.58, where FY29 = FY28 x 1.144 (SA 3Y EPS CAGR).
disagreements.resolution: FY29 was mis-derived. SA's screener names the metric 'EPS Growth Next 3Y', i.e. growth over the next three fiscal years (FY27-FY29) from the last reported year (FY26), not a per-year rate to apply after FY28. Consistency check: PANW's 3Y revenue CAGR of 17.31% from FY26 ($11.48B) gives FY29 revenue of $18.53B, +14.2% over FY28 consensus of $16.23B, in line with FY28's +14.49%. So FY29 EPS = $3.84 x 1.144^3 = $5.75 (estimate), and Oct-2027 NTM = 0.816 x 4.88 + 0.184 x 5.75 = $5.04 (estimate). The effect is +0.6% (about +$1.5/share at 52x). It is immaterial to the ladder but corrected in fair value. FY29 consensus itself is behind SA's paywall, so the figure stays an estimate.
disagreements.evidence: StockAnalysis PANW forecast (FY27 $4.19, FY28 $4.88, revenue $14.17B/$16.23B; FY29 marked 'Pro') and statistics (3Y EPS 14.40%, 3Y revenue 17.31%); Q4 FY26 release (FY26 non-GAAP EPS $3.84). StockAnalysis screener field list ('EPS Growth Next 3Y', 'Rev. Growth Next 3Y').

On a single consistent basis (NTM non-GAAP P/E on both PANW and peers, and SA trailing GAAP-basis EV/FCF on both), PANW is 97.3x vs a 51.65x peer median and 83.4x EV/FCF vs 41.3x. About $15-25 of the drop in agents 1-4 below their relative values is a method choice: an absolute SBC-burdened DCF at 9-10% would also value the peers far below their prices. I do not treat it as an error, but I do not use it in the reconciled FV, because peer multiples already embed peers' own SBC. Relative-only FV is $261 (citation gate: $262 before deducting the $825M Embrace/Console cash).

disagreements.topic: Ladder medians ($343-367) far above fair values ($236-258)
disagreements.positions: Every agent's scenario-weighted mean ($354-376) and ladder median sit $85-130 above its FV.
disagreements.resolution: Not a mistake, and argued in all five. FV is a full-normalisation value; the 12-month price assumes the 97x multiple closes only about half the gap to peers (base cases at 70-75x Oct-2027 NTM EPS). Each ladder reconciles with its own scenario mixture (ladder means slightly above scenario means because of lognormal convexity). Two internal inconsistencies remain: agents 3 and 4 put fair value BELOW their bear cases ($236 vs $255; $238 vs $265), so their own 'fair-value convergence' bears are not at their FVs. The half-close assumption is judgment. Base-rate support is thin: agent 5's 2021 analog shows full or over-normalisation for high-multiple peers, but PANW itself was flat. So the centre carries real uncertainty in both directions, and that is why confidence stays low.

confidence_reason: Round 2 settled every factual dispute: peer median 51.65x, Oct-2027 NTM EPS $5.04, EV/FCF basis, share count, net cash, report date and T-bill. But none of them moves the 12-month distribution by more than ~1%, because the agents' ladders are driven by how much of the 97x-vs-52x premium survives 12 months, and that is a judgment no search settles. The ladder therefore stays at the forecasters' mean.
thesis_break_reason: $220 is about the reconciled peer-median multiple (51.65x) on today's NTM EPS ($4.32), i.e. a price that implies zero EPS growth over the next year even at a peer multiple. It is also ~44x Oct-2027 NTM EPS ($5.04) and well below the 2026-05-27 low of $243.04 (Twelve Data). Multiple normalisation alone reaches ~$255-270 on intact estimates, so a sustained trade below $220 would most likely mean estimate cuts: an NGS ARR guide cut below +22%, the 40% FY28 FCF-margin target withdrawn, or CyberArk/identity slippage (goodwill $22.0B of $48.5B assets).
key_drivers: Multiple, not earnings: 97.3x consensus NTM non-GAAP EPS ($4.32) vs a 51.65x median of 10 security-software peers on the same calendar-weighted NTM basis; EV/FCF 83.4x vs 41.3x.

Consensus EPS path: FY27 $4.19 (+9.1%, depressed by 112M CyberArk shares), FY28 $4.88 (+16.5%), FY29 ~$5.75 (estimate) -> Oct-2027 NTM ~$5.04. Growth at the horizon (~17%) is only slightly above the peer 3Y median (16.3%).

FY27 guide and targets verified in the Q4 FY26 release: revenue $14.10-14.20B (+23-24%, ~6 months inorganic), NGS ARR $11.075-11.175B (+22-23%), EPS $4.16-4.19, adj FCF margin 38%, 40% in FY28, $20B NGS ARR by FY30. Organic revenue growth was +14.2% in Q3 FY26 (derived: ($3,002M - $388M) / $2,289M - 1).

Balance sheet: net cash $6.13B at 2026-07-31 (~$5.31B after the $825M cash paid for Embrace and Console in Aug/Sep 2026; ~$10.3B at Oct-2027 if FY27 FCF is retained); 818M basic shares; FY27 diluted guide 844-847M; converts at fair value $1.774B.

Sentiment and volatility: +97.5% in 12 months and nearly 3x off the Feb-2026 low; 3M realized vol 57.7%, 1Y 47.4%; the sector AI-security re-rating (CRWD 186x, NET 225x NTM) can persist or unwind together, which is the main 12-month swing factor.

fair_value.reason: Two relative methods, equal weight, valued at 2027-10-06, all inputs verified or derived with arithmetic shown. (1) P/E: 53x (10-peer NTM median 51.65x + 2.6% growth premium; see comps_review) x Oct-2027 NTM non-GAAP EPS $5.04 (0.816 x FY28 consensus $4.88 + 0.184 x FY29 $5.75, where FY29 = FY26 $3.84 x 1.144^3 per SA's 3Y EPS CAGR) = $267.1. (2) EV/FCF: 41.3x (10-peer trailing EV/FCF median, SA GAAP-FCF basis) x FY27 GAAP-basis FCF $5.01B (38% guide x $14.15B midpoint x 0.932 GAAP/adjusted ratio from FY26: $4,113M/$4,414M) = EV $206.9B; + horizon net cash $10.32B ($6.132B at 2026-07-31 - $0.825B cash paid for Embrace ($325M) and Console ($500M), both closed after the balance-sheet date per 10-K Notes 8 and 20, + $5.01B FY27 FCF retained) = $217.2B / 850M diluted shares = $255.6. Blend = (267.1 + 255.6) / 2 = $261 (estimate), 38% below spot. Round-1 $284 -> $262 in round 2, then $261 at the citation gate (the $825M Embrace/Console cash consideration, found in the 10-K, comes out of horizon net cash: -$1). Round-1 to round-2: premium cut from +10% to +2.6% (-$10), EV/FCF moved to the trailing GAAP basis at the horizon (-$18), FY29 correction (+$1). Sensitivity: zero premium $258; the 12-peer median with FFIV and CVLT (46.9x) gives ~$246. The agents' FVs corrected for verified facts only (EPS $5.04): agent 1 ~$238, agent 2 ~$243, agent 3 ~$236, agent 4 ~$238, agent 5 ~$259 (also deducting the $825M Embrace/Console cash from each agent's net cash). Their remaining gap to $261 is the SBC-burdened DCF weight (agents 1-4) and today's rather than horizon net cash (agents 2-4). Not a GAAP/SBC or fiscal-year artifact: both sides are on a non-GAAP NTM basis and the methods exclude any DCF.

summary: All five revised forecasts put PANW's fair value 39-44% below the $419.91 close. This is a genuine relative overvaluation call, not a GAAP/SBC or fiscal-year artifact: on one consistent NTM non-GAAP basis PANW is 97.3x vs a 51.65x security-peer median, and 83.4x vs 41.3x on EV/FCF. Round 2 confirmed the company facts at primary sources (818M shares, 112M CyberArk shares, net cash $6.13B at 2026-07-31, NGS ARR $9.10B, RPO $21.2B, no earnings before Nov 5). It also corrected two round-1 supervisor figures the agents had inherited: the peer median (49.5x -> 51.65x) and the Oct-2027 NTM EPS ($5.01 -> $5.04). Reconciled fair value is $261 ($262 before the citation gate deducted the $825M cash paid for Embrace and Console) and the thesis breaks below ~$220. The 12-month ladder stays at the forecasters' mean (median ~$356, P(>=spot) 0.34), because how much of the premium survives a year is judgment that no search settled.
